correctness.rationale: For every positive a,b,c,d, the local minimal-absence criterion is simultaneous occurrence of length-(|u|-1) prefix and suffix and absence of u. Partition factors by zero, one, two, three, or four-plus letter transitions; the four-run structure makes the mixed rectangular boundary unique and excludes all four-plus transition candidates. I checked the distinct family descriptions, exact inequality/equality boundaries, generating polynomial H(z), and summed the six conditional singleton indicators in all nine a-vs-c,b-vs-d comparison regions. Independent literal-factor enumeration of 625 parameter quadruples 1..5 reproduced every proposed minimal absent word and M(W)=b+c+(4 if a>c,b<d; 1 if a<=c,b>=d; 2 otherwise). The finite checks are corroboration, not an infinite theorem.
